newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline gains $2-3, but trade still slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline gains $2-3, but trade still slow.

text.p: NWE gasoline stormed $3 a tonne higher on Thursday as NYMEX gasoline played a leading role in the energy complex that saw screen crude breach heavy resistance.

Dealers said arbitrage opportunities to the United States were looking less certain than a few days ago. The general mood was that it might be possible with low octane material, but unlikely to work for high octane barrels.
Despite the surge in prices it was more talk-led than trade-led, dealers said.
A eurograde cargo was talked at $194/195 cif Hamburg and a regular grade 20,000 tonne piece was sold out of Poland at around cif high quotes +2.
Eurograde barges traded in the morning at $188 before gaining an extra $ or so. August paper was done at $193.50 with September valued around $191.00
-- Matthew Jones, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
